rows.authority: Blueprint §4/§13 requires explicit rounding; exact numeric choices are owner proposal

Domain contracts specify the controlling per-domain envelope and budget: geometry uses1e-11 relative for nonzero well-conditioned results with exact zero/classification; statistics uses1e-40 relative Decimal results; graph scalar evaluation uses its explicit absolute/relative1e-12 policy. Ill-conditioned cases need proved bound, high precision fallback or typed precision refusal, not widened epsilon. Decimal statistics use their stricter100digit-oracle criterion. Plot/analysis error budgets are separate and must be reported.

Ill-conditioned cases need proved bound, high precision fallback or typed precision refusal, not widened epsilon. Decimal statistics use their stricter100digit-oracle criterion.
